checks.result: 159 passed in 187.44s. Four design spaces; both modules are parameterised over whatever the repository declares, so coral arrived already covered by the same cases.

checks.name: Every served figure is tracked in git
checks.result: Passes over all four design spaces' figures, including coral's growth mp4. Added after seven xenobot figures 404d in production while every other test was green.

checks.name: The published model contains no temperature variable, verified independently
checks.command: scan of the cloned coRal repo for temp/thermal/heat/degC/DHW with positive controls
checks.result: Confirmed here rather than relayed: thermal, heat, degC and DHW return zero files; the single 'temp' match is '# used for temporary files' in .Rbuildignore and is named and dismissed. Positive controls fire - symbiont 14 files, light 14, photo 12, carbon 9 - so the zeros are measured zeros. R 4.3.3 is installed at /usr/bin/R, so the agent's port-versus-R cross-check to 5e-15 is a real cross-check. The confound it identified is visible in one line of the upstream source, def_pars.R:43 'b=rep(5, nsym)  # Scaling parameter for bleaching response'.

checks.name: Two defects caught at integration review and fixed before publication
checks.command: read control_arm against the study's own headline; read the quotable block against the message quoting it
checks.result: (1) The morphology headline asserted 'Both pre-declared controls pass' while control_arm.passed was false in the same file, said two controls where there are six, and offered box dimension 2.43 - the FAILING measurement - as evidence of passing. Regenerated from control_arm; it now names the failing check and carries the estimator control. (2) A figure quoted to the integrator as 94% reads 87% in the file it came from, where 0.935 is P(one intervention in the top two) and 0.87 is P(exactly those two ARE the top two); the page uses 87%. Both are the same failure class the receipts for the previous three releases record: a prose claim about one's own data, restated away from the data.
